nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=42 beats='the new fridge arrives and the empty box is left on the front step; it is brown and taller than the child and smells of tape and clean dust; a corner is dented in a friendly way; the child walks all the way around it'>>

<<FILL role=setup words=40 beats='the grown up helps tip out the crinkly white paper until the box is empty; a knuckle on the side makes a deep boom like a drum; inside it smells warm and papery and every sound goes big'>>

choices.label: Decide what the box will be.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=46 beats='the box can be two things and the child gets to pick; tipped on its side it makes a low dark den with a doorway at the end; stood up tall it is a tower that wobbles like a giant on tiptoe; both look wonderful'>>

choices.label: Tip the box on its side.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='the box rolls onto its side with a soft whump and now it is a long low tunnel; the carpet shows through the open end; kneeling down and looking in, the far end glows a little where the light gets through the tape'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=44 beats='the grown up holds up the safety scissors and offers to cut a proper doorway flap in the side; but the open end is already right there and warm and waiting; the child can have a door or can simply crawl in'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=44 beats='snip snip and the flap swings open and shut like a real door with a real creak; it needs one more thing to be finished; a knocker drawn on the front, or a letter slot cut just above it'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=42 beats='a fat brown knocker is drawn on with felt tip and it looks almost real; now somebody has to knock; the grown up is waiting outside with a knuckle ready, and the cat is watching the door with very round eyes'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=46 beats='knock knock says the grown up on the cardboard door and the whole den booms; the child answers who is there in a big deep voice; they play the knocking game over and over and the box turns out to be the best door in the house'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=46 beats='the cat pushes the flap with her nose, walks in, turns around twice and sits down like she paid for it; there is no room left for anybody else; the child lies on the carpet and looks in through the doorway at one very pleased cat'>>

<<FILL role=rising words=38 beats='the slot is cut long and thin above the door and a hand can just fit through it; from inside the den the slot is a bright stripe of kitchen light; something ought to come through it'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=42 beats='the grown up asks what kind of post this house would like; a drawing folded very small would fit, and so would the flat red leaves from the doormat that blew in this morning'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=46 beats='a folded drawing slides through the slot and lands on the child in the dark; it is a picture of the box with a child inside it; the child posts one back out and the slot becomes a proper post office all afternoon'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='red leaves come through the slot one at a time and spin down in the dark like slow flat birds; soon the floor of the den is a crackly red carpet; the child lies in the leaves and listens to them whisper'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=44 beats='inside it is dim and warm and the child breathes cardboard; two things would make it better; the torch from the hall drawer, or a window cut in the side to let the room back in'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=44 beats='the torch clicks on and the den turns gold; a hand held up makes a shadow bird on the end wall; the grown up says a fork poked through the roof would let real stars in, and there is also a blanket by the sofa'>>

<<FILL role=completion words=48 beats='tiny holes go through the cardboard roof and the torch shines up through them; the whole den fills with little white dots that move when the torch moves; the child lies flat on the carpet under a sky made this afternoon out of a box'>>

<<FILL role=rising words=38 beats='the big grey blanket goes over the box and hangs down past the doorway; now no light gets in except the torch; it is the quietest place in the whole house and it smells of wool'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=42 beats='the cushion is in, the torch is on its side making a warm puddle, and the child is very comfortable; there is time for a story read out loud through the doorway, or for a proper lie down'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=46 beats='the grown up sits outside the doorway and reads, and the words come into the box sounding round and close; the child holds the torch under the blanket and turns the pages from the inside; every story is better in a box'>>

<<FILL role=completion words=46 beats='the torch goes off and the dark is soft and grey; outside the kettle clicks and a bird goes past the window; the child falls asleep in the box with both socks off and is carried up to bed later without waking once'>>

<<FILL role=rising words=38 beats='a small square window is cut in the side and the room comes back in a bright neat block; from in here the sofa looks far away and the light lies on the child in a warm stripe'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=42 beats='the window frames whatever the child points it at; turned one way it holds the front garden and the bus stop; turned the other way it holds the kitchen doorway where the grown up keeps walking past'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the window holds one bus stop and two waiting people and a pigeon; the bus comes and fills the whole square with red and then goes and leaves an empty pavement; the child watches three buses and does not get bored once'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='every time the grown up crosses the kitchen doorway a hand comes out of the little window and waves; every time, the grown up waves back without stopping; it becomes a rule of the house for the rest of the day'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=46 beats='the box goes up on its end and it is taller than the child by a whole head; it sways when it is touched; the child can climb straight in and see what happens, or draw on it first while it stands still'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the child climbs in and the tall box leans, and leans, and folds down slowly like a tired animal; it ends up flat on the carpet with the child sitting in the middle of it laughing; the grown up laughs too and nobody is hurt'>>

<<FILL role=rising words=40 beats='felt tips come out and the tall box gets covered in circles and arrows and stripes; the child stands back to look; from here the drawings could belong to two completely different machines'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=44 beats='the circles could be dials on a rocket that is pointed at the ceiling; or they could be the buttons of a lift with a floor for every one of them; the box waits to find out which'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=44 beats='the dials are coloured in and a red one is chosen for the launch; the grown up is ready to count backwards from ten; or the scissors are ready to cut a round porthole so the child can see out first'>>

<<FILL role=completion words=48 beats='ten nine eight, and the whole family joins in from the kitchen; on zero the child jumps and the box hops off the carpet and lands again with a boom; they do it four more times because it works perfectly every single time'>>

<<FILL role=rising words=38 beats='a round hole is cut high up where the child has to go on tiptoe to reach it; one eye at a time fits; through it the living room looks small and far below, the way the ground looks from a plane'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=42 beats='the porthole can point at anything; swung round to the garden it holds the moon already up over the shed in the afternoon sky; swung the other way it holds the hall mirror and a face looking back'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the moon is out early and pale over the shed and the porthole holds it exactly; the child keeps one eye there for a long time while the sky goes slowly orange; the moon does not move and neither does the child'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=46 beats='in the hall mirror the porthole makes a perfect round window with a face in it, and the face is wearing a cardboard box; the child waves at the astronaut and the astronaut waves back at exactly the same moment, every time'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=44 beats='the buttons get numbers and the child presses them with a serious face; the top button goes to the roof where the pretend garden is; the bottom button goes down to the basement where it is cold and echoey'>>

<<FILL role=rising words=38 beats='the child hums a rising hum for going up and up and up; the grown up plays the part of the lift and says the floor numbers out loud; the humming gets very high and then stops'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=42 beats='ping says the grown up and the cardboard doors slide open; outside there could be a roof garden full of pretend tomatoes, or there could be more lift music and a very long ride'>>

<<FILL role=completion words=46 beats='the doors open on the roof and the roof turns out to be the sofa, which is allowed today; there are cushion hedges and a lamp for a sun; the child grows a whole garden up there and invites the cat, who accepts'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the doors shut again and the grown up hums lift music with no tune at all; floor after floor goes past and none of them is the right one; it is the silliest song in the house and it goes on for ages'>>

<<FILL role=choice words=44 beats='the humming goes down instead and gets low and rumbly; the box sounds different when the child hums low inside it, buzzy against the ears; the button below the basement has no number on it at all'>>

choices.label: Press the button with no number.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the doors open on the basement and the basement is dark and cold and full of nothing; the child says hello in a low voice and the box says hello back all buzzy; then the giggling starts and the lift has to close its doors'>>

ending.title: The Floor With Nothing On It

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=42 beats='below the basement the numbers run out and the humming goes as low as a child can hum; something is down here; the grown up asks whether it has feet or fins'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the doors open on a floor of warm mud and enormous slow footsteps going past; the child does not step out; the doors close again and the lift takes a long time coming back up, and that is exactly right'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the doors open under water and the whole floor is a slow green sea with something long swimming past; then the crinkly packing paper is pushed in around the child, which is nearly the same thing, and the lift fills up with sea'>>
